criteria.text: Two disposable souls provision sequentially and concurrently with isolated lineage and DM routing.
Exact replay, conflicting replay, process restarts, relay disconnect/backfill, and failure compensation are deterministic.
Durable secret-free observability identifies build, instance, run, stage, readiness, DM gate, terminal truth, retries, rollback, denial, orphan, and mismatch evidence.
Alert definitions cover stuck stage, progress without terminal, false running, orphan candidates, repeated Signet denial, and correlation mismatch.
Repository-derived inventory maps incumbents to ownership rules without credentials or live contact.
Operator runbooks cover deploy, inspect, trace, retry, reconcile, abort, backup/restore, policy rotation, cleanup, rollback, and incident response.
Rollout uses pinned source commits, requires immutable image digests, progresses through two canaries, and preserves valid identities on rollback.
